notes.title: Playtest 2 closing soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Many, many thanks for playtesting part 2, your input been very valuable!
As we will now focus on processing your feedback, we will be closing the playtest.

You have until tomorrow, the 15th of June (4AM PDT, 1AM EDT, or 10 AM CEST) to enjoy the game and submit reports. 

Stay tuned for Playtest 3, that one will probably be the last!

Enjoy the game and again, many thanks for your help!

The Lake Team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40153271/4feb3897176aaf83af472c9f5e4bba0d08b59761.png[/img]

notes.title: Playtest #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After processing a lot of your wonderful feedback, we're reopening the playtest. In this second playtest, you'll be able to play until day 8.
You can submit your feedback in-game (by pressing F8), or after the game, in a survey.

Not all of your initial feedback has been fixed yet, meaning we still have plenty of work left!

Enjoy the game and many thanks in advance for your help!

The Lake Team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40153271/a9ba0316dd1c1f37ed5f7fdbb4c9c2a50c57f8dc.png[/img]

notes.title: Lake Playtest closing
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for your amazing support and feedback. We greatly appreciate all the love for the game!

We will process your feedback and continue to work on finishing the game! There's a tiny chance we may need your help to test some other things, but we're quite confident we'll see you again when the game launches. Thanks again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40153271/de529bd6c63694cbeaf8e21ae4016f021b1e16ba.png[/img]
